benchmarks.name: Kiosk Kaffee
benchmarks.businessModel: High-velocity Grab-and-Go Kiosk Franchise. Monetizes per beverage cup (₹90 - ₹220).
benchmarks.digitalExperience: Basic e-commerce brochure with franchise inquiry forms. Slow performance (~4.2s mobile load), heavy plugin overhead, zero customer time/booking interaction.
benchmarks.limitations: No concept of time spent, zero co-working or studio infrastructure, purely transactional, sterile customer engagement.
benchmarks.maujiDifferentiation: Mauji does not sell disposable cups in a hurry — Mauji sells 'the luxury of time & creative belonging'. Mauji's digital product must feature live check-in, real-time rate calculators, studio bookings, and community event RSVPs which Elementor struggles to do without bloating.

benchmarks.name: Third Wave Coffee / Blue Tokai
benchmarks.techStack: Custom Shopify Plus / Next.js Headless & Mobile App
benchmarks.businessModel: Specialty cafe chain + D2C bean subscription. High cup price (₹250 - ₹380 per cup). Customers buying 2 coffees pay ₹550+ just to sit for 2 hours.
benchmarks.digitalExperience: Modern polished D2C storefront and loyalty app. Great aesthetics but entirely focused on beverage commerce.
benchmarks.limitations: No workspace guarantees, unstable Wi-Fi at busy times, waiters repeatedly prompt customers to order more, awkward for 6-hour work sessions.
benchmarks.maujiDifferentiation: At Mauji, 2 hours of unlimited specialty brews + snacks + guaranteed power desk costs only ₹420 (saving money compared to Blue Tokai), with zero guilt or waiter interruptions.

benchmarks.name: GoFloaters / MyHQ / WeWork
benchmarks.businessModel: Corporate desk aggregation & monthly flexible office space. Day passes typically ₹400 - ₹900 without artisanal cafe experience.
benchmarks.digitalExperience: Functional booking engines, corporate feel, transactional UI.
benchmarks.limitations: Sterile corporate ambiance, no bohemian community warmth, average instant coffee vending machines, strict corporate timings.
benchmarks.maujiDifferentiation: Mauji bridges the warmth of an artisanal bohemian coffeehouse with the productivity of a modern co-working sanctuary, plus creator podcast studios and weekend pottery/art events.

options.pagePerformance: Poor (Lighthouse 35-55 on mobile due to heavy DOM & plugin scripts)
options.interactiveCapabilities: Very Limited (requires custom PHP/AJAX for check-in dashboards & calculators)
options.verdict: Suitable for simple coffee menu brochures, but fails to handle Mauji's hybrid Time Cafe check-in, live rate calculations, and dynamic AI assistant.

options.stack: Headless Custom React / Next.js / Vite + Tailwind CSS
options.speedToLaunch: Fast with modern component libraries (1-2 weeks)
options.pagePerformance: Ultra High (Lighthouse 95-100, sub-second loads, instant page transitions)
options.interactiveCapabilities: Unlimited (Native interactive calculators, QR check-in dashboard, AI Chatbot widget, instant city switching)
options.securityMaintenance: Near Zero (No WordPress database attack vectors, static CDN hosting)
options.verdict: Recommended! Gives Mauji a world-class, premium feel that matches international boutique hospitality brands like Ace Hotel & anti-cafe pioneers.
